item.title: Panera Bread: Buy One Entree, Get Another for $5 — Code BOGO5
item.guid: Panera Bread-Buy One Entree, Get Another for $5 — Cod-2026-08-06
item.description: Use promo code BOGO5 at online or app checkout to get a second entree for only $5 when you buy one at full price; a free MyPanera account is required to apply the code. (Limited time)

item.title: Panera Bread: Free Pastry or Sweet with Any Purchase — Code TREAT4UCR
item.guid: Panera Bread-Free Pastry or Sweet with Any Purchase —-2026-08-06
item.description: Add code TREAT4UCR at checkout on the Panera app or website to receive a free pastry or sweet item with any purchase, no minimum required. (Limited time)

item.title: Popeyes: $5 Faves Menu — 3-Piece Chicken, 2 Sides, or Sandwich
item.description: Pick any item from the $5 Faves Menu including three pieces of chicken, two individual sides, or a chicken sandwich for just $5 at participating locations nationwide. (Through August 31, 2026)

item.title: Arby's: $7.99 Meat and 3 Box
item.description: Get a Ham and Swiss Melt, Crispy Chicken Sandwich, or Buffalo Chicken Sandwich plus three sides and a small drink for $7.99 at participating Arby's locations. (Limited time)

item.title: Subway: $6.99 Footlong — Code 699FORFTL
item.description: Enter promo code 699FORFTL at checkout on the Subway app or website to get any footlong sub for $6.99, a strong everyday value on a filling meal. (Limited time)

item.title: Taco Bell: $5.99 Luxe Cravings Box

item.title: Wendy's: $1 Small Classic Frosty

item.title: A&W Restaurants: Free Root Beer Float Day — Free Small Float Today Only

item.title: Chipotle: Free Delivery on $10+ Digital Orders
item.description: Chipotle is waiving its delivery fee (typically $1-$3 per order) on digital orders of $10 or more for a limited time. Order in the app or at chipotle.com - no code needed. Only a saving if you were ordering delivery anyway; service fees still apply. (Limited time)

item.title: Chili’s: 3 For Me: Drink + App + Entree from $10.99
item.guid: Chili’s-3 For Me: Drink + App + Entree from $10.-2026-08-06
item.description: Chili’s all-day 3 For Me bundles a bottomless drink, an appetizer (chips and salsa or house salad), and a full entree starting at $10.99, with $14.99 and $16.99 tiers - every day at participating locations, no membership needed. (Ongoing)
